reason: Adds ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex model access to DeepSeek Harness, with integrated search, image input, image generation, browser configuration, and CLI account management.

summaries.zh: 将 ChatGPT OAuth 登录和 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供搜索、图像输入、图像生成及网页和命令行配置功能。
summaries.en: Connects ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness with search, image input, image generation, and web or CLI configuration features.

capabilities: ChatGPT OAuth login and token refresh
Requests to the OpenAI Codex backend for language models
Codex web search through the existing web_search tool
Saving generated images to the active workspace
Browser and CLI account configuration and quota display
